Disclaimers

Last updated: February 2026

Nature of this platform

The India AI Tracker is an independent aggregation platform maintained by Kanan Labs. It collates publicly available news, policy updates, government announcements, and industry developments related to artificial intelligence in India — at both the state and national level.

This site is intended as a research and discovery tool for policymakers, researchers, journalists, and professionals seeking to monitor AI governance and technology developments in India. It does not produce original reporting, editorial content, or independent analysis.

No affiliation

The India AI Tracker is not affiliated with any government body, regulatory authority, news organisation, or commercial entity. Views, statements, or positions expressed in aggregated third-party content belong solely to their original publishers and do not represent the views of Kanan Labs or its operators.

Intellectual property

This platform does not claim ownership over any third-party material. All content aggregated here — including articles, announcements, and reports — remains the intellectual property of its original publishers. Every entry on this platform links directly to the original source, and no content is hosted, reproduced, or republished in full.

Brief summaries are provided solely to aid discovery and contextual understanding. The explicit intent of this platform is to direct readers to primary publishers and original sources. No content is paywalled, monetised, or presented in a manner intended to divert traffic from source publications.

Source removal requests

If you represent a news outlet, publisher, or content owner that would prefer not to be included in this aggregation, we will respect that preference without question. Please write to us at feedback@kananlabs.in identifying the relevant entries or source, and we will remove them promptly.

Accuracy & corrections

While we endeavour to represent all aggregated material accurately and fairly, we cannot guarantee the completeness or currency of the information presented. If you have identified an error, a missing development, or a misattribution, please contact feedback@kananlabs.in. All reasonable correction requests will be reviewed and addressed promptly.

No legal or professional advice

Nothing on this platform constitutes legal, regulatory, financial, or professional advice of any kind. Content is provided for informational purposes only. Readers should consult appropriate professionals before acting on any information found here.
